_doc: Character bible — single source of truth across ALL chapters. Chapters sync from here (evaluate.mjs --sync-cast).
_strategy: ICONIC TRAIT SILHOUETTE. Each character is lightweight (few clean shapes, reproducible on prompt-only FLUX) yet (a) reflects their novel character/role and (b) is unmistakably distinct for readability. Design on 3 ORTHOGONAL axes so no two characters share the same distinguishing value: (1) SILHOUETTE = build+height, read first at a glance; (2) HEAD = a unique hat/hair signature (the most reproducible tag); (3) TRAIT-MARK = one prop/feature that encodes their defining trait or arc. Plus a default EXPRESSION for temperament. Rule: distinguish by the PRESENCE of a unique signature, never by hairstyle alone or the absence of a feature; keep signatures shape-based (grayscale-readable).

victor.name: Victor
victor.head: untidy dark hair + round glasses
victor.trait_mark: a stained lab apron and dark feverish shadowed eyes (obsession & guilt)
victor.canonical: a lean, slightly hunched young man with untidy dark hair, round glasses, dark shadowed feverish eyes, wearing a stained lab apron
victor.anchor: round glasses, a stained lab apron and dark shadowed eyes
victor.consistency: the ONLY one with round glasses + apron; bare-headed; tired shadowed eyes show his obsession/guilt; never a hat.

creature.name: the Creature
creature.role: the made being — intelligent, eloquent, desperately lonely, then vengeful
creature.head: bald with one bold forehead stitch-seam
creature.trait_mark: a bolt at the neck and a few heavy seams on the arms (assembled from parts), with deep sorrowful hollow eyes (his tragedy, not mere horror)
creature.canonical: a very tall gaunt figure, chalk-white skin, bald head with one bold black stitch-seam across the brow, a bolt at the neck, heavy seams on the arms, deep sorrowful hollow eyes, sharp teeth, ragged shirt
creature.anchor: tallest gaunt bald body, a brow stitch-seam, a neck bolt and sorrowful hollow eyes
creature.consistency: always the TALLEST, gaunt; bald with a single bold brow seam + neck bolt (made of parts); eyes read as sorrowful, not just scary.

clerval.name: Clerval
clerval.role: loyal friend — cheerful, adventurous, poetic dreamer
clerval.head: a black top hat
clerval.trait_mark: a long travel scarf and a book of poems tucked under one arm (the wandering poet)
clerval.canonical: a cheerful upright young man in a black top hat and a long travel scarf, a book of poems under his arm, bright smiling face
clerval.anchor: a black top hat, a long scarf and a book under the arm
clerval.consistency: the ONLY one in a top hat; buoyant and smiling; scarf + book mark the wandering poet.

elizabeth.name: Elizabeth
elizabeth.role: cousin & beloved — gentle, devoted, the family's moral heart
elizabeth.head: a white bonnet over a long braid
elizabeth.trait_mark: bright fair GOLDEN hair (her defining beauty, all ages), an oval locket at her throat and a shoulder shawl
elizabeth.canonical: a gentle graceful young woman with bright fair golden hair in a long braid under a white bonnet, an oval locket at her throat and a shoulder shawl
elizabeth.anchor: bright fair golden hair, a white bonnet, an oval locket and a shawl
elizabeth.consistency: ALWAYS bright fair/golden hair (her defining trait across every age); a bonnet as an adult; braid + shawl; never glasses, never an apron.

alphonse.name: Alphonse
alphonse.role: father — wise, loving patriarch and magistrate
alphonse.head: balding grey hair, no hat
alphonse.trait_mark: a long white beard and a walking cane, in a long coat
alphonse.canonical: a tall stooped elderly gentleman, balding grey hair, a long white beard, leaning on a walking cane, in a long coat
alphonse.anchor: a long white beard and a walking cane (elderly, stooped)
alphonse.consistency: the ONLY bearded elder with a cane; stooped; no hat, no gown (distinct from Waldman).

ernest.name: Ernest
ernest.role: younger brother — lively, outdoorsy, not studious
ernest.head: a flat newsboy cap
ernest.trait_mark: an open-collar shirt, sleeves rolled, an easy outdoorsy stance
ernest.canonical: a wiry teenage boy in a flat newsboy cap, open-collar shirt with rolled sleeves, no glasses, eager restless look
ernest.anchor: a flat newsboy cap and rolled-sleeve open collar
ernest.consistency: the ONLY one in a flat cap; a lean teen; no glasses, no apron.

justine.name: Justine
justine.role: servant girl — sweet, devoted, tragically wronged
justine.head: a white servant's cap
justine.trait_mark: a plain apron-dress and gently clasped hands (humble, devout)
justine.canonical: a slight sweet-faced young servant girl in a white servant's cap and a plain apron-dress, hands gently clasped, anxious gentle face
justine.anchor: a white servant's cap and clasped hands
justine.consistency: the ONLY one in a small white servant's cap; modest and gentle.

william.name: William
william.role: little brother — innocent child, the first victim
william.head: a little sailor cap
william.trait_mark: a sailor collar, dimples, and the same oval locket (links him to Elizabeth and the plot)
william.canonical: a tiny cherubic boy in a little sailor cap and sailor collar, dimples, wearing an oval locket, giggling
william.anchor: a little sailor cap, sailor collar and an oval locket
william.consistency: the only small child; sailor cap + locket (the locket ties to Elizabeth/the murder plot).

waldman.name: Waldman
waldman.head: bald dome + half-moon spectacles
waldman.trait_mark: a scholar's gown and a warm open-handed gesture (encouraging)
waldman.canonical: a benevolent bald old professor with half-moon spectacles and a scholar's gown, warm open-handed gesture, clean-shaven
waldman.anchor: a bald head with half-moon spectacles and a scholar's gown
waldman.consistency: kindly professor: bald + half-moon specs + gown, clean-shaven (distinct from bearded Alphonse and wigged Krempe).

krempe.name: Krempe
krempe.head: a curly powdered wig
krempe.trait_mark: a jabbing pointed finger and a permanent scowl (pompous, dismissive)
krempe.canonical: a short squat gruff professor in a curly powdered wig, permanent scowl, a jabbing pointed finger
krempe.anchor: a curly powdered wig, squat build and a jabbing finger
krempe.consistency: short + squat + powdered wig + scowl (distinct from tall bald professors).

caroline.name: Caroline
caroline.role: Victor's mother — devoted daughter, then gentle benevolent mother
caroline.head: dark hair in a neat centre-parted bun, no hat
caroline.trait_mark: a small cross necklace and a high-collar dark dress (devout, careworn tenderness)
caroline.canonical: a graceful woman with dark hair in a neat centre-parted bun, a small cross necklace and a high-collar dark dress, warm careworn face
caroline.anchor: dark hair in a centre-parted bun, a cross necklace and a high-collar dark dress
caroline.consistency: the ONLY grown woman with a bun + cross necklace; no bonnet (that is Elizabeth), no servant cap.

beaufort.name: Beaufort
beaufort.role: Caroline's father — a proud merchant ruined into poverty, dies
beaufort.head: balding grey, no hat, no beard
beaufort.trait_mark: a threadbare once-fine coat and a proud broken bearing (fallen gentleman)
beaufort.canonical: a gaunt sunken balding grey man, clean-shaven, in a threadbare but once-fine coat, a proud broken bearing
beaufort.anchor: gaunt balding grey, clean-shaven, in a threadbare fine coat
beaufort.consistency: gaunt sick fallen gentleman; balding, clean-shaven, no cane (distinct from bearded Alphonse).
